title: Rate Limits
description: API rate limits ensure stability and fair usage for todos los usuarios.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: QRise enforces rate limits on a per-API-key basis. If you exceed these limits, the API will respond with a 429 Too Many Requests error.

sections.title: Rate limit headers
sections.content: Every response includes headers to help you track your usage:
items: X-RateLimit-Limit: Total requests allowed per window
X-RateLimit-Remaining: Requests remaining in current window
